visual_goal: Show hosts and merchant hotels paid by the platform after collection, agency hotels paying commission back, and every movement posted to one settlement ledger.
prompt: A left-to-right landscape diagram. At the far left, one generic guest figure. In the center, a teal building labeled 'Platform'. On the right, three destinations stacked vertically: a small house labeled 'Host', a hotel labeled 'Merchant hotel', and a hotel labeled 'Agency hotel'. Arrows: one green arrow from the guest to 'Platform' labeled 'pays at booking'; one blue arrow from 'Platform' to 'Host' labeled 'payout'; one blue arrow from 'Platform' to 'Merchant hotel' labeled 'virtual card'; one green arrow from the guest along the bottom directly to 'Agency hotel' labeled 'pays at property'; one orange arrow from 'Agency hotel' back left into 'Platform' labeled 'commission'. Below the Platform building, an open ledger book labeled 'Settlement ledger', connected to the Platform by a thin dotted line.
alt: A guest pays the platform, which pays a host and a merchant hotel; the guest pays an agency hotel directly, which pays commission back to the platform; every movement is posted to a settlement ledger.

visual_goal: Show the settlement ledger at the center, with events feeding postings in, and the payout engine, invoicing and statements only reading from it.
prompt: A hub-and-spoke illustration with a large open ledger book at the center labeled 'Settlement ledger'. On the left, a box labeled 'Earnings calculator' with one arrow into the ledger labeled 'postings', and above it a small stream of event tags labeled 'Events' with one arrow into the calculator. On top, a timer box labeled 'Release scheduler' with one arrow down into the ledger, and a shield box labeled 'Trust' with one arrow into the scheduler. On the right, three boxes each receiving one arrow from the ledger: 'Payout engine', 'Invoicing' and 'Statements'. From 'Payout engine' one arrow right to a generic bank building labeled 'Banks'. The ledger is visibly the largest element.
alt: Events feed an earnings calculator that posts to a central settlement ledger; a release scheduler guided by trust changes balance states; payout engine, invoicing and statements read from the ledger, and the payout engine pays banks.

visual_goal: Show the states of a payable, with a returned transfer going back to available and a hold as its own state.
prompt: A state map of rounded stones on a path from left to right: 'Pending', 'Available', 'In transit', and a green end stone 'Paid', with one arrow between each consecutive pair. Above 'Pending', an orange stone 'Held' with one arrow from 'Pending' up into it and one arrow from it down-right into 'Available'. Below 'Pending', a grey stone 'Reversed' with one arrow from 'Pending' down into it and one arrow from 'Held' curving down into it. One curved blue arrow from 'In transit' back to 'Available', labeled 'returned'.
alt: Payable states Pending, Available, In transit and Paid, with Held and Reversed branches, and a returned transfer going from In transit back to Available.
